about: The table of examples of the status an order shows from its dishes. The client (POS/src/utils/kitchenBands.js, kitchenStatusOf) and the server (pos_next/api/restaurant.py, _order_status_of) are each tested against THIS file, so that the status the server writes on the order and the one the screen works out cannot drift apart. `dishes` are the kds_status of the order's lines (null: none), `status` what the order shows while its own status is not Delivered. `ahead_cases` (the service rhythm, NeoResto lot 1): each dish is `{status, uncalled}`, `uncalled` being a dish that left AHEAD of its course and is not called yet; the order follows the dishes that are called, and when only uncalled dishes are live it is Pending until one is begun and Preparing after that, never Ready.

ahead_cases.about: only dishes sent ahead and not called, none begun: Pending, a ticket to start if the cook wishes
only dishes sent ahead, one begun: Preparing
only dishes sent ahead and all finished: never Ready, nothing waits at the pass for a course nobody called
the starters delivered, the mains ready ahead: the order is not Ready
the starters delivered, the mains sent ahead and not begun: Pending
the starters being cooked, the mains ahead: the order follows the starters
the starters ready, the mains ahead and not begun: the order follows the starters alone, so it is Ready
the starters not begun, the mains finished ahead: Pending, the finished mains do not begin the order
every dish called is ready, the one ahead too: Ready
a dish held back and a dish ready ahead: Preparing
a ticket with two courses delivered and one sent ahead and started
